notes: Every quarter's 'q' block is copied from the quarter column of the release that first published that quarter (Q4 from the Q4 revenue release or, from 2019 on, the full-year results release; 2019 Q4 from 2020-02-26 results release since no Q4 2019 sales release is in txt/). Repeated tables in later releases of the same fiscal year (e.g. Q1 reprinted in H1 release, Q4 reprinted in annual results) were compared and are identical.

2014 quarters (and H1/9M/FY 2014 cum) come from the prior-year comparative column of the 2015 releases; no 2014 growth rates are printed there, so cc_growth/cur_growth are absent. 2015 Q1 comparatives reflect the tableware reclassification restated retrospectively (per 2015 Q1 release footnote).

Q3/14 and Q3/15 (and 9M/14, 9M/15) were printed only as whole numbers in the 2015 Q3 release; the 2016 Q3 release reprints Q3/15 and 9M/15 to one decimal (Q3/15 = 1,143.1) under q_comparative_next_year. 2015 Q1-Q3 sum vs 9M differs by rounding only.
From 2022 (Q4 2021 onward) Hermes prints whole EUR millions; 2023 Q1..Q4 sum (13,426) vs FY 13,427 and similar +/-1 differences for H1/9M are rounding, not extraction errors.
Q4/21 is printed as whole millions (2,380) in the 2021 annual results release, while Q1-Q3 2021 are printed to one decimal.

'*_comparative_next_year' blocks hold the same period as reprinted in the following year's release (identical=false is in all cases rounding or decimal precision differences, no restatements found beyond rounding).

Source typos handled: '240,6' (Q4 2014 Europe excl. France, 2015 Q4 release) and '187,6' (Q2 2014 Europe excl. France, 2015 Q2 release) read as 240.6 and 187.6. Year headers misprinted in source: 2017 Q1 release sector table shows '2017 2017' and the Q1 sector reminder in the 2017 Q2 release shows '2016 2015'; values match the 2017/2016 geo tables, treated as 2017 vs 2016.

Source-internal inconsistencies (printed % growth at current rates does not match printed values; copied as printed): Q1/15 Other Hermes sectors 19.5% (72.2 vs 60.5 implies 19.3%); H1/15 Other geo; Q4/15 Other geo -0.1% (18.5 vs 18.6); H1/16 Other geo; Q2/19 Watches 10.1% (47.1 vs 42.7 implies 10.3%); Q3/19 Other geo; Q1/21 & H1/21 Other geo; Q2/21 Japan 109.9% (227.8/108.6 implies 109.8%), Q2/21 Silk/Perfume/Other products; H1/21 Other products. All are small (<=0.4pt) and likely computed on unrounded data.

Labels: 'Perfumes' became 'Perfume and Beauty' from 2020/2021; 'Other' geo became 'Other (Middle East)' in later releases; 'Leathergoods' / 'Leather Goods' etc. all mapped to the same keys. Geo/sector totals (Total Europe, Total Asia) omitted; geo and sector items sum to total within rounding for every period.
2021 releases also give growth at constant rates vs 2019: stored as cc_growth_vs_2019 / geo_cc_vs_2019 / sector_cc_vs_2019.
Not used: the 'Reminder of previous publications' multi-column tables in 2015-2020 releases (rounded to whole millions); half-year/annual reports (rapportfinancier/URD).
